05-11.solution: The 15% cut saves \(0.15 \times 510 = 76.50\) rupees, and that buys the extra 3 kg, so the reduced price is \(\frac{76.50}{3} = 25.50\) rupees a kg.

05-26.solution: Each year the value is multiplied by 0.85, so two years ago it was \(\frac{361250}{0.85^2} = \frac{361250}{0.7225} = 500000\) rupees.
